title: maqtal me tha jo laashae asghar tamaam raat
body:
Maqtal Me Tha Jo Laasha-E Asghar Tamaam Raat
Jangal Me Dhoondti Rahi Maadar Tamaam Raat
<<DIVIDER>>
Uriyaa'n Thi Laash-E Shamma-E Shabistaan-E Mustafa
Parwaana Waar Phirti Thi qwaahar Tamaam Raat
<<DIVIDER>>
Baba Ko Yaad Karke Sakina Na Sothi Thi
Usko Na Chain Aata Tha Dum Bhar Tamaam Raat
<<DIVIDER>>
Ro Ro Ke Haaye Aapne Chacha Ko Pukaar Kar
Baali Sakina Maanga Ki Gauhar Tamaam Raat
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek Be Watan Ke Qatl Ki Tayyariyaa'n Jo The
Barpaa Tha Fouj-E Shaam Me Mehshar Tamaam Raat
<<DIVIDER>>
Qabze Ko Choomte Rahe Talwaar Toul Kar
Shouq-E Jihaad Me Rahe Akbar Tamaam Raat
